integrity: The result includes its complete proof and standalone finite checks. Tests of finitely many instruction strings are not a substitute for the infinite argument. Public prior literature is explicitly identified; neither novelty beyond inspected materials nor external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula applies to dyadic prefixes of length 2^k, k>=3, of binary generalized paperfolding words; no statement is made for arbitrary lengths, nonbinary alphabets, multiplicities, or a complete description of missing scattered subsequences. One plausible relevant 2015 full text was inaccessible and unindexed equivalences may exist.
title: Dyadic scattered-subsequence universality of generalized paperfolding words
